CustomField.description: Customer acronym (CCC segment) used to build Opportunity.Project_Code__c. Read live from the Opportunity's Account by ProjectCodeService, so a change here reaches an Opportunity on its next save (or via the project code backfill). Branch accounts of the same customer share an acronym (e.g. every Greentech office).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 3-letter customer code used as the CCC segment of the project code (e.g. GTR for Greentech Renewables). Without it the Opportunity gets no project code.
CustomField.label: Naming Acronym
